exposure: Hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (gestational hypertension, chronic hypertension, preeclampsia without severe features, preeclampsia with severe features, superimposed preeclampsia, eclampsia)
outcome: Maternal admission to the intensive care unit (ICU)
cohort: The study included 183 women in their third trimester of pregnancy or within 24 hours following childbirth, categorized into control, gestational hypertension, chronic hypertension, preeclampsia (with or without severe features), superimposed preeclampsia, and eclampsia groups.
finding: Overall, no association was found between optic nerve sheath diameter (ONSD) and hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, but greater ONSD was specifically observed in women with eclampsia compared to controls and was associated with maternal ICU admission and maternal near miss.
